events.name: Laughterama: Michelle Wolf & Rose Matafeo
events.pleaseNote: Over 16s only. Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult over 18. A max of 8 tickets per person and per household applies. Tickets in excess of 8 will be cancelled. Lineup: Michelle Wolf, Rose Matafeo, Bella Hull, Amy Annette, Sarah Keyworth, Phil Ellis
events.info: LAUGHTERAMA, Manchester's biggest comedy festival returns to Castlefield Bowl with five nights of astounding all-star stand-up, craft beers, street eats & more. ROSE MATAFEO BELLA HULL AMY ANNETTE SARAH KEYWORTH PHIL ELLIS A special guest headliner to be announced is joined by an almighty line-up starring Starstruck creator, BAFTA nominee and Edinburgh Comedy Award winner Rose Matafeo. "A near-perfect comedian" - The Guardian Joining Rose is a huge bill with viral phenomenon Sarah Keyworth, superstars in the making Bella Hull and Amy Annette, plus Taskmaster dark horse Phil Ellis as host. Doors 18:15 Show 19:30
